title: ir.integrity.*
description: Trust Architecture §6.1: the 14 workaround-attempt signals, emitted ONLY by platform components (Zone M/G) and attributed by workload certificate -- never by a payload field, so one principal cannot frame another (threat T14). `principal` is populated from the caller's mTLS identity at the transport layer by the emitting component, not supplied by the agent whose behavior triggered the signal.

principal.description: The workload identity this signal is attributed to, from the mTLS certificate presented on the offending call -- never from a request payload field (defeats threat T14, framing another agent).

weight_applied.description: The signal's current weight in the suspicion-score formula (Trust Architecture §6.1); null if not yet scored.
